bosses.name: Hellcat, Hellcat
bosses.strategy:
They're not too bad; just have Yuri fuse into the Raging Tiger and wail
on them with regular attacks while Alice keeps both of you healed with
either Cure or Thera Leaves.

bosses.name: Felinus
bosses.strategy:
This lady isn't to be taken lightly. She can use the Wind Fang ability to
hit everyone for Wind damage, and after a couple of turns, your whole
party will be in need of healing, so beware.

Since she's a Wind class, have Yuri fuse into the Raging Tiger and use
the Flying Stones skill to do some decent damage to her, followed by
regular attack. Alice should be keeping everyone healed, as should
Zhuzhen. If no one needs healing then, have Zhuzhen use his Ogre
Flamedance spell, and Alice should attack normally. As long as you stay
healed and don't let Alice go Berserk, you should be fine.

bosses.name: Yamaraja: Earth
bosses.strategy:
Note that Yamaraja: Earth is actually a WATER class. As I mentioned
above, he's pretty dangerous! If you can't beat him, level up in town for
a while before trying again. I recommend at least level 6 for everyone.

His Flash Flood will hit an ally for pretty good damage, while his Large
Whirlpool will hit your entire party for major damage, as well as
possibly halving your Hit Area on your Ring, so be sure to heal after it
hits. His physical attacks are also nothing to sneeze at, as they can
take away large chunks of HP at a time. Make sure that Alice and Zhuzhen
are in the back row, and when in doubt, just heal.

Have Yuri fuse into the Raging Tiger and use his Flying Stones attack,
followed by normal attacks. Have Alice stay on healing duty the entire
time, and have Zhuzhen cast Ogre Flamedance continuously. If needed, have
Yuri supplement healing since Zhuzhen's fire magic probably hits for more
than Yuri does, and make sure to keep Alice from becoming Berserk.

As for Meiyuan, he can't fight, but his acupuncture allows you to increase the Attack Power of your weapon, the Hit Area on the Judgment Ring, or both. It costs a lot of money to do it at this point, so I don't recommend it. We'll be able to buy new weapons in the next town which will be stronger anyway. However, if you're having trouble hitting areas on the Judgment Ring, then by all means, try to increase the Hit Area if you can afford it. This next boss is REALLY tough if you're at a low level. I strongly recommend fighting until everyone in your party is at least level 6 before continuing on; it should only take a few battles. If you get some extra money, those Leather Belts and Bandannas for everyone would probably be a good idea.
After the battle, remove everything you can from Zhuzhen.

When you regain control, head back south to the first area of town, where
you'll find an [_ANGEL'S FEATHER_], roughly around the center of the area, just
to the lower-right of a pile of sticks. Go back up to the previous screen, then
follow along the right side until you see the '?' icon near another pile of
sticks. There is a [_BRONZE ARROWHEAD_] to be found here. Continue north to the
next area.

Use the Save Point here to save and clear Malice in the Graveyard if needed,
then check around the right side of the well here by a board on the ground to
find a [_TENT_]. Go all the way to the right, then all the way up; the corner
up here by the Lost Peddler/Wandering Merchant has a [_TALISMAN OF LUCK_] lying
on the ground.

Feel free to shop with the Wandering Merchant; I using your money for just
healing items for now, such as some Thera, Mana, and Pure Leaves, if you have
the extra money. Pure Leaves will really come in handy in the first part of the
game, where characters like Alice have hardly any SP and can't last in a long
battle without going Berserk. We'll be visiting another town soon, so we'll be
able to go shopping there with some more money. If you have some extra now, or
if the money's just burning a hole in your pocket, then buy some Leather Belts
and Bandannas so you have 3 each for your active party, and if you do, make
sure to equip both Yuri and Alice with both of them before continuing on.

When you're ready, head all the way north to the next area. Watch the events
here, then enter the house the children invite you to and continue watching the
events unfold. After some rest, you'll have to take on two Hellcats.

After the battle, head back into the house and examine the dresser at the very
top of the screen to find a [_PHOENIX TAIL_]. Go back outside, then make your
way north back to the shrine. After a scene with the Cat Lady, head back to the
previous area and make your way to the left side of the well, where you'll
encounter her again. Head south to the second area, where you'll run into her
yet again. Continue south back to the first area.

Here, you'll run into the Quack Oracle, who will introduce himself as the true
ruler of the nine heaves, the absolute sage Master Li Zhuzhen, referred to as
Zhuzhen from here on out. You'll also meet Wanderer Meiyuan the acupuncturist,
who's got a thing for Yuri, and would love to just stick his needles in him...
Zhuzhen will decide to help you out and will temporarily join your party!

  NOTE     Zhuzhen comes equipped with an [_OAK STAFF_] and a [_COTTON SHIRT_]
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   by default. As for Meiyuan, he can't fight, but his acupuncture
           allows you to increase the Attack Power of your weapon, the Hit Area
           on the Judgment Ring, or both. It costs a lot of money to do it at
           this point, so I don't recommend it. We'll be able to buy new
           weapons in the next town which will be stronger anyway. However, if
           you're having trouble hitting areas on the Judgment Ring, then by
           all means, try to increase the Hit Area if you can afford it.

  NOTE     If you want to see how much it would cost to power up your weapons,
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   check out section A-1-08 for the cost for every weapon in the game.

Once you regain control, continue north to run into the Cat Lady once again.
Afterward, head back to the center of town to run into her again, then go back
into the house you were lured into in the first place. After a scene here,
you'll learn that you need to find a Metal Vessel and a Torch to use with the
[_ANTI-CAT POWDER_] you receive from Zhuzhen to continue.

Head back outside, then make your way south to the second area. Here, follow
along the western side of the area until the '?' icon pops up, allowing you to
attempt a Normal Ring, just like in battle, to pick up the [_METAL BOWL_] we
were looking for.

Continue south to the entrance, then examine the building just to the right of
Meiyuan to find the [_TORCH_] among a pile of sticks. Now that we have both
items that we needed, make your way back to the center of town and use the Save
Point. When you're ready, enter the Cat Lady's house again and examine the pit
in the center. After an event, you'll have to fight her.

Once she's done, head back to the Save Point and use a Tent to recover your HP
and MP.

  NOTE     This next boss is REALLY tough if you're at a low level. I strongly
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   recommend fighting until everyone in your party is at least level 6
           before continuing on; it should only take a few battles. If you get
           some extra money, those Leather Belts and Bandannas for everyone
           would probably be a good idea.

When you're ready, head back north to the shrine and examine it. Do you dare
violate the shrine?

After the both the battle and following scene are over, examine the shrine once
again to find a [_SHELL BRACELET_]. Head back south through town, talking to
the Lost Peddler on the second screen for a [_SNAKE CARD_], which is a Guild
Card that can be used for a discount in Shops.

That's it for Zhaoyang Village, so go ahead and make your way to the gate,
where Zhuzhen will leave your party. Afterward, head out to the World Map. Our
next destination is Fengtian!
